content.short: A CLI toolkit to assemble and disassemble function calls and their results, and to analyze ABIs for encoding and decoding smart contract functions.
content.description: Rust Ethereum ABI is a command-line toolkit for assembling and disassembling function calls and their results, providing developers with a clear window into how ABI-encoded interactions map to contract behavior. It enables assessing the predictability of outcomes for smart contract ABIs and offers a method to reverse engineer a basic ABI from a known contract to achieve a desired output. The tool works with ABIs generated by the latest Solidity compiler versions, ensuring compatibility with current compiler releases and conventions.
